channel.title: Keel releases — public docs and site
channel.description: Public-facing releases for Keel, the open-source job-application autopilot that refuses to lie. One item per commit touching public docs or the site.

item.title: Launch push: audited data-story, launch-copy corrections
item.description: docs/data-story.md published with every figure counted directly from the ledger and telemetry (55 submissions at launch, 60 now, 5 fabrication-gate leads, 198 leads stopped, 1,109 telemetry events). Launch drafts corrected to the 55-at-launch canon.

item.title: GEO layer: replace unverified rival claims with verified set
item.description: Two rival-side claims found unsupported were removed from the GEO docs and replaced with the verified source set. Canon claims only.

item.title: GEO layer: llms.txt, citation-ready docs/geo, JSON-LD structured data
item.description: llms.txt and llms-full.txt added; docs/geo Q&A set (FAQ, honest automation explainer, comparison, alternatives, stats, spot-check protocol); JSON-LD structured data on the site.

item.title: Repo polish: contributor funnel
item.description: Contributor onboarding and repo polish: README, CONTRIBUTING, issue templates, changelog.

item.title: Add Keel web home (site/): static GitHub-Pages-ready page
item.description: Static site for GitHub Pages: proof figure, truthfulness contract, open-core model, one-brand note.

item.title: Fix README: ledger-verified 55 submissions, drop unprovable 48h window
item.description: README corrected to the ledger-verified 55-submissions figure; the unprovable 48-hour window claim removed.
